lesson.title: 第十一課：我要租房子

dialogues.title: 對話一
dialogues.content:
如玉：林先生，你好，我是白如玉，來看房子。
房東：白小姐，妳好，請進。
房東：這裡是客廳，廚房在左邊，右邊有浴室。
如玉：房子很不錯。
房東：這裡很方便，附近有超市和捷運站，走路五分鐘就到了。
如玉：現在有人住嗎？
房東：有。還有兩間空房間，一間是套房，一間不是。
如玉：我想看套房。房間裡面可以上網嗎？
房東：可以。妳覺得這間房間怎麼樣？妳想租嗎？
如玉：我回去想想，再打電話給你。
dialogues.content_py:
Rúyù：Lín xiānshēng, nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì Bái Rúyù, lái kàn fángzi.
Fángdōng：Bái xiǎojiě, nǐ hǎo, qǐng jìn.
Fángdōng：Zhèlǐ shì kètīng, chúfáng zài zuǒbiān, yòubiān yǒu yùshì.
Rúyù：Fángzi hěn búcuò.
Fángdōng：Zhèlǐ hěn fāngbiàn, fùjìn yǒu chāoshì hàn jiéyùnzhàn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
Rúyù：Xiànzài yǒu rén zhù ma?
Fángdōng：Yǒu. Hái yǒu liǎng jiān kōng fángjiān, yì jiān shì tàofáng, yì jiān bú shì.
Rúyù：Wǒ xiǎng kàn tàofáng. Fángjiān lǐmiàn kěyǐ shàngwǎng ma?
Fángdōng：Kěyǐ. Nǐ juéde zhè jiān fángjiān zěnmeyàng? Nǐ xiǎng zū ma?
Rúyù：Wǒ huíqù xiǎngxiang, zài dǎ diànhuà gěi nǐ.
dialogues.content_en:
Ruyu：Hi, Mr. Lin. I am Bai Ruyu. I'm here to look at the house.
Landlord：Miss Bai, how are you? Please come in.
Landlord：This is the living room. The kitchen is to the left. The bathroom is to the right.
Ruyu：The place is nice.
Landlord：It is conveniently located. Nearby, there are a supermarket and an MRT station. Walk five minutes and you're there.
Ruyu：Does anyone live here now?
Landlord：Yes. There are still two vacant rooms. One is a suite (a room with a bath) and the other one is not.
Ruyu：I'd like to take a look at the suite. Can you access the internet from the room?
Landlord：Yes. What do you think of this room? Do you want to rent it?
Ruyu：Let me go back and think about it. I will call you again.

dialogues.title: 對話二
dialogues.content:
如玉：喂，房東先生，你好，我是白如玉，你收到我的房租了嗎？
房東：我已經收到了，謝謝。妳習慣了嗎？
如玉：習慣了。可是，有一個問題，熱水器的水好像不熱。
房東：今天我會去看看。妳什麼時候有空？晚上可以嗎？
如玉：不好意思，今天晚上我有事。
房東：沒關係，明天下午呢？
如玉：好，我在家等你。
房東：那我明天下午兩點到。還有問題嗎？
如玉：我想買電視。請問可以幫我裝有線電視嗎？
房東：可以，不過妳得自己付錢。
如玉：好的，謝謝你。
dialogues.content_py:
Rúyù：Wéi, Fángdōng xiānshēng, nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì Bái Rúyù, nǐ shōudào wǒ de fángzū le ma?
Fángdōng：Wǒ yǐjīng shōudào le, xièxie. Nǐ xíguàn le ma?
Rúyù：Xíguàn le. Kěshì, yǒu yí ge wèntí, rèshuǐqì de shuǐ hǎoxiàng bú rè.
Fángdōng：Jīntiān wǒ huì qù kànkan. Nǐ shénme shíhòu yǒu kòng? Wǎnshàng kěyǐ ma?
Rúyù：Bùhǎo yìsi, jīntiān wǎnshàng wǒ yǒu shì.
Fángdōng：Méi guānxi, míngtiān xiàwǔ ne?
Rúyù：Hǎo, wǒ zài jiā děng nǐ.
Fángdōng：Nà wǒ míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎngdiǎn dào. Hái yǒu wèntí ma?
Rúyù：Wǒ xiǎng mǎi diànshì. Qǐngwèn kěyǐ bāng wǒ zhuāng yǒuxiàn diànshì ma?
Fángdōng：Kěyǐ, búguò nǐ děi zìjǐ fùqián.
Rúyù：Hǎode, xièxie nǐ.
dialogues.content_en:
Ruyu：Hello, Mr. Landlord. This is Bai Ruyu. Have you received my rent?
Landlord：I have received it. Thank you. Are you accustomed (to living there)?
Ruyu：Yes. But there is a problem. The water from the water heater doesn't seem to be hot.
Landlord：I will go check it out today. When are you free? Would tonight be okay?
Ruyu：I am sorry. I've got something to do this evening.
Landlord：That is alright. How about tomorrow afternoon?
Ruyu：Okay. I will wait for you at home.
Landlord：I will be there at two. Are there any other problems?
Ruyu：I want to buy a television. Could I trouble you put in cable for me?
Landlord：Yes, but you will have to pay for it yourself.
Ruyu：Fine. Thank you.

grammar_points.title: I. Come to Do Something with 來

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: 來 + VP

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: 來 followed by a verb phrase expresses coming to a place with the intention or purpose of doing something.
blocks.ex:
我來學中文。
他來打籃球。
我和朋友來逛夜市。

blocks.label: Word Order
blocks.text: Negatives, auxiliary verbs, and adverbs precede the first verb 來.
blocks.ex:
我明天有事不來上課。
她不跟我來看電影。
我很忙，不來幫你裝有線電視了。

blocks.label: Questions
blocks.text: Ask with 嗎, or use A-not-A on 來 or on the auxiliary verb.
blocks.ex:
他不來吃晚飯嗎？
你們常來游泳嗎？
你要來參觀故宮博物院嗎？
你明天來不來我家看電視？

blocks.label: Usage
blocks.text: 來 + VP works like 去 + VP in Lesson 3. The only difference is direction: 來 is toward the speaker, 去 is away from the speaker.
blocks.ex:
我星期四來／去上書法課。
我妹妹不想來／去吃牛肉麵。

grammar_points.title: II. Sooner Than Expected with 就

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Time/Condition + 就 + VP

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: 就 before the main verb phrase indicates that an event occurs earlier, faster, more easily, or more smoothly than expected.
blocks.ex:
學校很近。走路十分鐘就到了。
那個地方不遠。很快就到了。
他等一下就來。
走路五分鐘就到了。

blocks.label: Structures
blocks.text: 就 often co-occurs with the sentence-final 了. The sentence means the same with or without 了.

blocks.label: Usage
blocks.text: 就 is a high-frequency adverb with several functions. Here it is used within a single sentence; in Lesson 9 it was a linking adverb connecting S2 to S1.

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: 有 + Indefinite Noun + VP

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: Use 有 to introduce an indefinite or previously unknown person or thing as the subject. The VP that follows describes what the subject does.
blocks.ex:
有人住這裡。
有兩個學生來找你。
早上有一個小姐打電話給你。
昨天有一個先生來裝有線電視。
有一個人在外面唱歌。

blocks.label: Negation
blocks.text: 有 is always negated with 沒. Use 沒有 to state that an indefinite subject does not exist.
blocks.ex:
這間沒有人住。
沒有人要跟我去逛夜市。
沒有學生要去故宮。

blocks.label: Questions
blocks.text: Ask with 嗎, or with 有沒有.
blocks.ex:
有人在裡面看書嗎？
有沒有人想去 KTV 唱歌？
有沒有人要跟我一起去花蓮玩？
有沒有人不喜歡吃日本麵？

blocks.label: Comparison
blocks.text: Both structures express existence. 有 + NP + 在 + Place focuses on what exists; Place + 有 + NP highlights the location.
blocks.ex:
地上有一支手機。
有一支手機在地上。

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: 會 + Skill

blocks.label: Acquired Skill
blocks.text: 會 can indicate an acquired skill learned through study or practice (會1, introduced in Lesson 5).
blocks.ex:
他會做飯。
我不會打籃球。

blocks.label: Possibility
blocks.text: 會 can also indicate the possibility, probability, or tendency of a future event (會2).
blocks.ex:
我明天會去看看他。
他明天不會去上書法課。

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: 零代詞 Zero Pronoun

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: In Chinese, old information that has been mentioned before or that is understood from the context is often omitted later. A pronoun that is omitted is called a “zero pronoun”.

blocks.label: Structures
blocks.text: The most frequently omitted element is the subject — either predictable from the context, or previously mentioned.
blocks.ex:
請進！
要買什麼？
請問外帶還是內用？
今天晚上要一起吃晚飯嗎？
聽說臺灣有很多小吃。
我姓王，叫開文。
我常打籃球，也常踢足球。

blocks.label: Object
blocks.text: The object may also be omitted once it has been mentioned.
blocks.ex: 昨天朋友給我一個芒果，我不想吃。

lesson.activities:
I. Life in Taiwan / Photo Journal
【目標 Goal】Learning to use indefinite subjects to describe events.
【做法 Task】安同 took a walk in his neighborhood on Sunday and took a few photos. He plans to upload them to Facebook. Write a caption for each one and describe where the action took place.
【例】有一個學生在學校打籃球。
有兩個女生在客廳喝茶。

II. Where I Live
【目標 Goal】Learning to talk about the environment of a room or house.
【做法 Task】Pair up with a classmate and describe your current residence or your residence back in your home country. As you listen to your partner, draw a floor plan of their house and label each room.
【例】廚房在左邊，右邊有浴室。

III. Story-telling
【目標 Goal】Learning to comprehend a passage and add things to it.
【做法 Task】Form groups of two or three. Read the following story and complete it with your partners. Read the completed story to the class and evaluate each group's work.
【例】李大同的女朋友昨天已經回國了。現在他一個人在家，他想，今天有一個很好看的網球比賽，可是現在十一點半了，比賽已經結束了。他不知道要做什麼，所以想去看看他爸爸媽媽，他爸爸媽媽的家很近，走路五分鐘就到了。他打電話給他爸爸媽媽，他爸爸媽媽說，他們去旅行，不在家。現在，李大同不知道要做什麼……（請幫他想想吧！）

IV. For Rent Ads
【目標 Goal】Learning to understand rental advertisements.
【做法 Task】You and your friend see the rent ad below. Carry out a discussion based on the following questions.
【例】租：近捷運站、超市、學校；兩套衛浴，有廚房；冰箱、網路、有線電視一應俱全；月租一萬五，不包水電。地址：師大路八巷六號二樓。意者請電王太太 02-73889012／0988123456。
租這個房子一個月要多少錢？
租這個房子，可以做飯嗎？
要是我想看房子，應該打電話給誰？打哪個電話？
什麼是「衛浴」？
你現在住的房子比這個房子好嗎？
要是你想租房子，你會租這個地方嗎？為什麼？

V. Something's Wrong with My Room
【目標 Goal】Learning to make requests, e.g., to your landlord.
【做法 Task】You have just started renting a place, but the internet is not working and the kitchen has no hot running water. Call your landlord, tell him/her about the problems, and ask him/her to take care of them. (Have a classmate role play the landlord.)
【例】不好意思，房間的網路不能用，熱水器也壞了。可以請你來看看嗎？
lesson.culture:
公布欄與網路上的租屋小廣告 Rentals on Bulletin Boards
在臺灣，除了房屋仲介與租屋網站，大專院校附近的公布欄及公寓一樓的租屋小廣告也是常見管道。廣告通常列出套房或雅房、設備、月租金及聯絡電話，學生可以撕下底部電話條直接聯絡房東，並省下仲介費。

什麼是「雅房」與「套房」？ 雅房 vs. 套房
套房內有獨立浴室與廁所，隱私性較高。雅房內通常只有床、書桌等家具，不含獨立浴室，房客需與同樓層住戶共用客廳、廚房或浴室。雅房一般比套房便宜，適合預算有限的學生。

questions.instruction: Identify whether 會 marks an acquired skill (會1) or future possibility (會2).

questions.prompt: 他等一下就「會」去看電影了。
我弟弟已經「會」騎機車了。
我跟女朋友明天不「會」去 KTV。
他「會」寫書法，可是寫得不太好。
